Context: FREOUENTL Y ASKED QUESTIONS

## FREOUENTL Y ASKED QUESTIONS  
1. What is Constant Attendant Allowance?  
Constant Attendant Allowance is granted to pensioners who retire on disability pension with 100% disability and are completely dependent on somebody for day-to-day function.  
2. Is there any minimum amount of invalid pension? Yes, it should not be less than the normal rate of family pension.
